indicator.name: Home birth rate
indicator.description: Percentage of live births in the two years before the 2022 Kenya Demographic and Health Survey that occurred at home.
indicator.expected_availability_note: Published for all 47 counties. KDHS 2022 county point estimate for live births in the two years before interview. The source-reported number of births is retained as survey precision metadata; individual reference windows vary with interview date.
